verdict.rationale: Fenwick operates client-facing technology, including a trademark extranet and AI brief and contract-review tools, so asking whether users can control retention and deletion of their data is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence describes a user-facing retention or deletion control. The privacy & cybersecurity practice page describes legal advice offered to clients, which is an adjacent service, not a capability that lets users control their own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
